reference_answer: The scheduler has a persistent locked ledger and exact frozen manifest/slot identities; current recovery docs prohibit silent replay of ambiguous native attempts and keep charges and reservations until reconciliation. The amended Stage A contract is a continuous 23-task, seven-arm cohort with one outcome per slot and a seal. A sound plan models reserved, running, terminal and ambiguous states, validates freeze/source/host/ownership receipts before resuming, distinguishes safe continuation from terminal failure or human reconciliation, and never creates a new attempt because a process disappeared. It should preserve original evidence and compare fail-closed versus authorized recovery paths with deterministic interruption tests and rollback.
